Name: TheSTouchscreen
Description: TheSTouch's mod for its iPad and iPhone port, built into it: the game played by touch and Apple Pencil (taps, drags and two-finger camera instead of an emulated mouse; while placing, a finger aims the ghost and Place places it, Rows drags rows of paths and walls), the HUD redesigned for an iPhone's screen, and Development controls as a touch-sized window.
